text: What we would not do

name: TextBox 12
text: EECE 490 · Stories Coffee Hackathon

name: TextBox 12
text: Ideas that sound good but the data says no

name: TextBox 15
text: End-of-day discounts

name: TextBox 16
text: Late evening is Stories’ busiest time, not its quietest. A discount there gives money to people already coming.

name: TextBox 19
text: Winter or holiday promotions

name: TextBox 20
text: January is the slowest month, but sales grew because more people came, not because of seasons. Holidays showed no effect.

name: TextBox 23
text: A “summer iced drinks” push

name: TextBox 24
text: Cold drinks stay at about 60% of sales whether it’s 14 °C or 25 °C. Weather doesn’t move demand.

name: TextBox 27
text: Bundle discounts

name: TextBox 28
text: Items bought together don’t prove a discount would sell more. It would mostly cut profit on sales we already make.
